Last week (Monday through Sunday) was **October 26, 2026 to November 1, 2026**. This assumes today is Monday, November 2, 2026, per the system date. The other date in my context said October 31, which would make last week October 19 to 25 instead. Tell me if you meant that week.

**Google steps, Oct 26 to Nov 1:**
- Every day shows exactly **2,000 steps**, so the weekly total is 14,000 and the daily average is 2,000.
- All 7 days have data, so there are no gaps.

**Treat these numbers with caution.** The raw records are tagged with the parser `eval-synthetic`, which suggests placeholder or test data rather than your actual activity. The identical value on every day is also unlikely for a real step counter. Check whether the Google import is correct before relying on these figures. If you want, I can re-sync the Google activity data or look at other weeks to see whether the same pattern appears.
